GRU.info: Gated Recurrent Unit is a recurrent neural network architecture designed to capture temporal dependencies while reducing computational complexity compared to LSTMs.

LSTM.info: Long Short-Term Memory network is a recurrent neural network architecture capable of learning long-term temporal dependencies in sequential data.

Bidirectional LSTM.info: Bidirectional LSTM processes sequence data in both forward and backward directions, allowing the model to learn context from past and future observations.

CNN-LSTM.info: Hybrid architecture that combines convolutional layers for feature extraction with LSTM layers for temporal sequence modeling.

Attention LSTM.info: LSTM architecture enhanced with an attention mechanism that enables the model to focus on the most relevant time steps during prediction.

Encoder-Decoder LSTM.info: Sequence-to-sequence architecture consisting of encoder and decoder LSTM networks, commonly used for multi-step forecasting tasks.

TCN.info: Temporal Convolutional Network uses causal and dilated convolutions to model long-range temporal dependencies efficiently.

WaveNet.info: WaveNet is a deep generative architecture that leverages stacked dilated causal convolutions for modeling sequential and time-series data.

Transformer.info: Transformer architecture relies on self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies and relationships within sequential data.

Informer.info: Informer is an efficient Transformer variant specifically designed for long-sequence time-series forecasting using ProbSparse attention.

FEDformer.info: Frequency Enhanced Decomposed Transformer improves long-term forecasting by combining decomposition methods with frequency-domain attention.

ProphetRegressor.info: Prophet-based forecasting model enhanced with external regressors to improve predictive performance.

ExponentialSmoothing.info: Forecasting method that assigns exponentially decreasing weights to older observations.

Holt-Linear.info: Extension of exponential smoothing that captures both level and trend components.

Holt-Winters.info: Triple exponential smoothing method that models level, trend, and seasonality.

ETS.info: Error-Trend-Seasonality state space framework for time-series forecasting.

ARIMA.info: Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average model for univariate time-series forecasting, combining autoregression, differencing, and moving average components.

SARIMA.info: Seasonal ARIMA extends ARIMA with seasonal autoregressive, differencing, and moving average terms to capture periodic patterns in time-series data.

Prophet.info: Forecasting model developed by Meta for handling seasonality, holidays, and trend changes.

TBATS.info: Trigonometric seasonality, Box-Cox transformation, ARMA errors, Trend and Seasonal components model designed for complex seasonal time series.

BATS.info: Box-Cox transformation, ARMA errors, Trend and Seasonal components model for handling multiple seasonalities in time-series forecasting.

Croston.info: Forecasting technique designed specifically for intermittent demand time series.

SBA.info: Syntetos-Boylan Approximation improves Croston's method by reducing forecast bias.

TSB.info: Teunter-Syntetos-Babai method for intermittent demand forecasting with probability updates.

Moving Average.info: Forecasting approach based on the average of recent observations.

min_periods.warning: min_periods must be less than or equal to window.

Weighted Moving Average.info: Moving average method assigning higher importance to recent observations.

EWMA.info: Exponentially Weighted Moving Average forecasting technique emphasizing recent values.
